scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.watch: concurrently -k -n web,server -c cyan,green "npm run watch:web" "npm run watch:server"
scripts.build:coderun-lite: npm install --prefix src/apps/coderun-lite/client && npm run build --prefix src/apps/coderun-lite/client
scripts.build: npm run build:coderun-lite && npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.build:apps: npm run package:desktop:windows && npm run package:desktop:linux && npm run package:mobile:android && npm run package:mobile:ios
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flypc/server && npm run test -w @flypc/web
